description: This Java class defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing several basic endpoints such as welcome, docs redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI, preserving the request's original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' status indicating the application's health.
